Amos 9:1.text: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar. He said, “Strike the atonement cover, and the foregates will shake; cut through the heads of all. I will kill their survivors with a sword. No one fleeing from among them will escape, and no one seeking safety will be saved.

Amos 9:2.text: If they burrow into Hades, My hand will pull them up from there; if they climb to heaven, I will bring them down from there.

Amos 9:3.text: If they hide on Carmel’s summit, I will search them out and take them from there. If they plunge from My eyes into the sea’s depths, I will command the dragon there, and it will bite them.

Amos 9:4.text: If they go into captivity before their enemies, I will command the sword there, and it will kill them. I will fix My eyes upon them for evils and not for good things.”

Amos 9:5.text: The Lord, Lord God Almighty, touches the earth and shakes it; all who dwell in it will mourn. Its consummation will rise like a river and descend like Egypt’s river.

Amos 9:15.text: I will plant them upon their land, and they will certainly never again be uprooted from the land I have given them,” says the Lord God Almighty.
